acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision states whether the Codex host's stream decoder must refuse duplicate and case-aliased members, with the threat model it relies on.
If refusal is required: DecodeEvents and its session and usage readers refuse a line that repeats a read member or aliases one by case, and a test shows that removing each check fails it.
body: Raised by the V1-0756 lane on 2026-10-05 and confirmed from source in the batch tree (claude/batch-2026-10-05 at 3ec6eeab plus V1-0701). V1-0755 and V1-0756 make the Claude Code and OpenCode supervisor stream readers refuse duplicate members and case aliases (exactMembers/aliasFree in internal/tasks/supervisor/hosts.go). In the V1-0756 review, a duplicate member let `"accepted":false,"accepted":true` pass, let a repeated `type` hide an `error` event, and let repeated token objects merge into usage that looked complete. The Codex host decoder, DecodeEvents in internal/tasks/supervisor/events.go:19, still uses json.Unmarshal into a map at lines 28, 51, 89, 96 and 117, so the last duplicate wins and case aliases are not checked. Expected: either the same refusal as the other hosts, or a recorded reason Codex output is exempt. Actual: no check and no recorded decision. This is a suspected defect: whether Codex's JSONL output can be shaped this way by a hostile turn has not been verified.

title: supervisor: Codex stream decoder accepts duplicate and case-aliased members that the Claude Code and OpenCode hosts refuse
